verdict.rationale: Wise's own site says users can lock in exactly what the recipient will get for up to 24 hours, which covers a rate guarantee over a fixed window before the transfer completes. The evidence is a single marketing line from the general wise.com page, with no Business-specific or API-level detail. Missing for 10: Business-account-specific documentation of the rate lock, API/quote-expiry documentation for programmatic use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can lock in an exchange rate for a fixed window before completing a transfer

citations.quote: Lock in exactly what your recipient will get for up to 24 hours. If the rate drops, you won’t lose out.
